effects: Marks the signer's (msg.sender, which must be an EOA) allocation as claimed, so it can be claimed only once.
Checks the Merkle proof for (signer, amount) and reverts if it is not valid.
If amount <= vestingThreshold: sends the full amount of BLAST (0xb1a5…E2ad) from the contract to the signer.

If amount > vestingThreshold: sends amount - ((amount - vestingThreshold) * vestingRate / 10000) BLAST to the signer now, and deposits the rest into AirdropVesting as a vesting position for the signer.
vestingThreshold and vestingRate are owner-set storage values, not constants. No native value is taken (not payable).
formats.shown: Claim <amount> BLAST airdrop to your address, with a note that the part above 1M BLAST vests; the Allocation field shows the amount in BLAST.

findings.title: claim: intent hardcodes a 1M BLAST threshold and says the whole excess vests; both are storage values.
findings.evidence: Airdrop.sol _claim: `vestedPortion = ((amount - vestingThreshold) * vestingRate) / BASIS_POINTS; distributedPortion = amount - vestedPortion;`, where vestingThreshold and vestingRate are set by setVestingParameters (onlyOwner). Descriptor interpolatedIntent: "the part above 1M BLAST vests". Only vestingRate% of the excess vests and the rest is paid now. The 1M figure is not in the code.
findings.fix: Write something like "part of any amount above the vesting threshold is locked in vesting", or check the on-chain values and state them exactly (threshold, and the rate that applies to the excess).

findings.title: claim: the BLAST paid out now cannot be computed on screen when the allocation is above the threshold.
findings.evidence: Airdrop.sol _claim: `BLAST_TOKEN.transfer(delegatedRecipient, distributedPortion)` and `airdropVesting.deposit(initialRecipient, delegatedRecipient, vestedPortion)`. The split depends on storage values, so the screen can show only the total Allocation.
findings.fix: None in ERC-7730. Keep the vesting note accurate.

effects: Only the Blast L2CrossDomainMessenger (0x4200…0007) can call it. The real claimant is MESSENGER.xDomainMessageSender(), the L1 sender, and its allocation is marked as claimed.
Checks the Merkle proof for (L1 sender, amount).
If amount <= vestingThreshold: sends the full amount of BLAST to delegatedRecipient.

If amount > vestingThreshold: sends amount - ((amount - vestingThreshold) * vestingRate / 10000) BLAST to delegatedRecipient, and deposits the vested portion into AirdropVesting with initialRecipient = L1 sender and delegatedRecipient as the controller of the vesting.
The L1 sender's whole allocation, both the paid and the vested part, goes to delegatedRecipient. Not payable.
formats.shown: Claim <amount> BLAST airdrop to <Recipient>, with a note that the part above 1M BLAST vests; the fields show the Allocation and the Recipient.

findings.title: delegateAndClaim: only the L2 messenger can call it, so no wallet user signs this calldata directly.
findings.evidence: Airdrop.sol delegateAndClaim: `if (msg.sender != address(MESSENGER)) revert Unauthorized();`. MESSENGER = 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000007 (meta.json). Cases 1 and 2 use from = 0x4200…0007. A user would sign an L1 sendMessage that wraps this calldata, so this screen only helps a wallet that decodes nested cross-domain messages.
findings.fix: Add a descriptor for the L1 messenger or bridge call that wraps this calldata, or a nested calldata field there.

findings.title: delegateAndClaim: intent hardcodes a 1M BLAST threshold and says the whole excess vests; both are storage values.
findings.evidence: Airdrop.sol _claim: `vestedPortion = ((amount - vestingThreshold) * vestingRate) / BASIS_POINTS`. vestingThreshold and vestingRate are owner-set. Descriptor: "the part above 1M BLAST vests". In case 1 (97,473,308 BLAST) the reader would think all ~96.5M above 1M is locked, which holds only if vestingRate is 100%.
findings.fix: Say "part of any amount above the vesting threshold vests", or state the exact on-chain parameters.

findings.title: delegateAndClaim: screen does not say the Recipient also controls the vesting position.
findings.evidence: Airdrop.sol _claim: `airdropVesting.deposit(initialRecipient, delegatedRecipient, vestedPortion)`. The natspec says delegatedRecipient is the "Address to recieve control of the airdrop." The descriptor's "Claim {amount} airdrop to {delegatedRecipient}" covers the immediate transfer but not that the vested tokens also go to the Recipient's control.
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Delegate your BLAST airdrop and its vesting position to {delegatedRecipient} and claim {amount}".

couldNotCheck: AirdropVesting.deposit(initialRecipient, delegatedRecipient, vestedPortion), called from Airdrop._claim at the address stored in airdropVesting: its source is not in the directory (omittedSources), so I could not check how the vested position is recorded or who controls it.
